title: Structure Characterization of Zinc Finger Motif 1 and 2 of GLI1 DNA Binding Region.
authors: Wu, Mousheng; Jahan, Nusrat; Sharp, Amanda; Ullah, Anwar; Augelli-Szafran, Corinne E; Zhang, Sixue; Boohaker, Rebecca J
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构与分子动力学模拟表征GLI1转录因子锌指基序1-2的同源二聚体构象，并利用大语言模型预测突变体稳定性，聚焦TF-DNA结合区域的结构特征，虽未直接研究DNA互作，但为TF-DNA结合机制提供结构基础与方法借鉴。
abstract: As a transcription factor, GLI1 plays an important role in cell cycle regulation, DNA replication, and DNA damage responses. The aberrant activation of GLI1 has been associated with cancers such as glioma, osteosarcoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma. The binding of GLI1 to a specific DNA sequence was achieved by five tandem zinc finger motifs (Zif motifs) on the N-terminal part of the molecule. Here, we reported a novel homodimeric crystal structure of Zif1-2. These two Zif motifs are linearized. Namely, Zif2 does not bend and interact with Zif1 of the same molecule. Instead, Zif1 from one molecule interacts with Zif2 from another molecule. The dimer interface of Zif1-2 is unique and different from the conformation of Zif1-2 from the GLI1-DNA co-crystal structure. The dimeric conformation of Zif motifs could represent the native conformation of apo form GLI1 Zif motifs in the cell. The molecular dynamics simulation result of the homodimer, the in silico mutagenesis, and the predicted protease stability of these mutants using a large language model are also presented.
abstract_zh: 作为一种转录因子，GLI1在细胞周期调控、DNA复制及DNA损伤应答中扮演重要角色。GLI1的异常激活与胶质瘤、骨肉瘤和横纹肌肉瘤等癌症相关。GLI1通过其分子N端部分的五个串联锌指基序（Zif motifs）实现与特定DNA序列的结合。在此，我们报道了Zif1-2的一种新型同源二聚体晶体结构。这两个Zif基序呈线性排列，即Zif2不弯曲，也不与同一分子的Zif1相互作用；相反，一个分子的Zif1与另一个分子的Zif2相互作用。Zif1-2的二聚体界面独特，不同于GLI1-DNA共晶结构中Zif1-2的构象。Zif基序的二聚体构象可能代表了细胞中apo形式GLI1 Zif基序的天然状态。此外，我们还展示了同源二聚体的分子动力学模拟结果、计算机模拟突变分析，以及利用大型语言模型对这些突变体预测的蛋白酶稳定性。
